tools.name: get_spot_prices
tools.description: Current USD gold, silver and platinum spot (checked hourly) and the gold-silver ratio. Use for a spot quote. Example: {}. Optional include (trade, cftc, digest, or all) adds market context.

tools.name: list_catalog
tools.description: List tracked products or stack-worth presets. Set type to products or presets. Example: {"type":"products","metal":"gold"}.

tools.name: get_dealer_prices
tools.description: Today's US dealer list prices for one tracked product, sorted by price; only offers checked in the last 120 minutes. Example: {"product":"american-silver-eagle-1oz","limit":3}.

tools.name: melt_value
tools.description: Melt value of gold, silver or platinum items or scrap jewelry: weight × purity (or karat) × spot. Example: {"weight":10,"karat":14,"offer_usd":500}.

tools.name: junk_silver_melt
tools.description: Melt value of 90% or 40% US junk silver by face value. Example: {"face_value":10}.

tools.name: premium_over_spot
tools.description: Premium over melt for a quoted price versus today's dealer asks. Example: {"product":"american-silver-eagle-1oz","price":60}.

tools.name: true_cost
tools.description: Delivered total (price + shipping + fees) for your quote or a dealer ranking. Example: {"product":"american-silver-eagle-1oz","quantity":20}.

tools.name: get_premium_index
tools.description: Bullion Premium Index (CC BY 4.0): lowest and median premiums over spot, plus 7-day low and median. Example: {"metal":"silver"}.

tools.name: get_dealer_leaderboard
tools.description: Dealer coin leaderboard for a 7-day or all-time window: ranks, coins, badges. Example: {"window":"7d"}.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Stored hourly or daily dealer price history for one product. Example: {"product":"american-silver-eagle-1oz","days":7}.

tools.name: product_spec
tools.description: Metal content and identity for one tracked product. Example: {"product":"american-silver-eagle-1oz"}.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Build a buy or sell quote from melt plus a margin you set, or a scrap intake quote (class=intake). Example: {"product":"american-silver-eagle-1oz","side":"sell","margin_pct":5}.

tools.name: bullion_sales_tax
tools.description: Whether a bullion purchase is taxed in a US state. Example: {"state":"TX","metal":"gold","amount":500}.

tools.name: bullion_trends
tools.description: Google Trends search-interest snapshot or product-demand view. Set mode to snapshot or demand. Example: {"mode":"snapshot","keyword":"gold price"}.

tools.name: dealer_feed_validate
tools.description: Validate a dealer price feed for required fields, freshness and identity. Example: {"records":[{"product":"american-gold-eagle-1oz","dealer_id":"shop-a","offer":{"unit_price":4260}}]}.

tools.name: inventory_aging_exposure
tools.description: Value and age exposure for dealer lots against current melt. Lots shorthand: carry_annual_rate defaults to 0. Example: {"lots":[{"product":"american-silver-eagle-1oz","quantity":10,"cost_basis_usd":500}]}.

tools.name: restock_plan
tools.description: Suggested restock from on-hand stock and recorded sales. sales_observations shape {status:'recorded', entries:[{date, quantity}]}. Example: {"items":[{"sku":"american-silver-eagle-1oz","on_hand":40}]}.

tools.name: buyback_compare
tools.description: Compare a bid to recorded dealer buyback bids, spot and melt tiers. Example: {"product":"american-silver-eagle-1oz","caller_bid_usd":52}.

tools.name: premium_history_alerts
tools.description: Flag unusual premium moves versus a product's recent history. Example: {"product":"american-gold-eagle-1oz","lookback_days":14}.

tools.name: fair_offer_check
tools.description: Screen an asking price against spot, melt and policy bands; returns buy, counter or pass, with counter and walk-away prices when a bid exists. Example: {"product":"american-gold-eagle-1oz","price":4250}.

tools.name: get_stack_worth
tools.description: Melt and estimated dealer value for a stack of coins, bars or custom weights. Example: {"items":[{"preset":"1-oz-silver-eagle","quantity":10}]}.

tools.name: bullion_calculator
tools.description: Gold return, DCA, IRA, allocation or income calculator. Set type to return, dca, ira, allocation or income. Example: {"type":"return","paid_usd":1300,"purchase_month":"2015-06"}.

tools.name: spot_move_check
tools.description: How much spot has moved over a short window. Example: {"metal":"gold","window":"24h"}.

tools.name: dealer_competitor_position
tools.description: Where your ask sits among today's tracked US dealer asks for one product. Example: {"product":"american-gold-eagle-1oz","your_price":4199,"payment":"bank"}.

tools.name: dealer_market_movers
tools.description: Largest 24h/7d movers in spot, dealer asks and premiums. Example: {"window":"both","metal":"gold","limit":3}.

tools.name: dealer_price_opportunity
tools.description: Lists high_premiums, discounts and pricing_gaps versus each product's history; held until 30-day history is available. Example: {"metal":"all","period_days":30}.

tools.name: dealer_quote_scenarios
tools.description: Up to three buy or sell margin scenarios for one product, side by side. Example: {"product":"american-gold-eagle-1oz","quantity":1,"scenarios":[{"side":"sell","margin_pct":4}]}.

tools.name: dealer_market_report
tools.description: Morning dealer brief (spot, dealer asks, premiums, largest 24h/7d movers and buyback bids), or a floor-sheet or bid-spread view. Set section to report, floor_sheet or bid_spread. Example: {"section":"report","metal":"gold","payment":"bank","movers_window":"24h"}.
